title: Generic Error with name 'JsonRpcMethodNotFoundError' misclassified as -32601 Method Not Found instead of -32603 Internal Error
action: Downstream handler throws standard Error with reassigned name: `const err = new Error('backend fault'); err.name = 'JsonRpcMethodNotFoundError'; throw err;`
expectation: Server distinguishes genuine typed instances/brands of JsonRpcMethodNotFoundError from generic internal errors, preserving -32603 for generic handler failures per the public caller contract.
reality: Server matches error strictly by string property `err.name === 'JsonRpcMethodNotFoundError'`, returning `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"err-generic-named","error":{"code":-32601,"message":"backend fault"}}`
evidence: Demonstrated in /Users/vanya/.bb/thread-storage/thr_9yjb93iwmn/protocol-named-generic-probe.json and /Users/vanya/.bb/thread-storage/thr_9yjb93iwmn/protocol-package/test-suite.mjs ('Generic error with name reassigned to JsonRpcMethodNotFoundError remains -32603')
